Example SNP genotype data and sample metadata

Source: R/data.R
example_data.Rd

DArTseq SNP genotypes for 257 individuals of an unpublished plant species collected in eastern Australia, with matching sample metadata. The species identity is withheld pending publication. data(example_data) loads two objects, example_gt and example_meta.

Usage

data(example_data)

Format

example_gt: a data frame with 257 rows (individuals) and 1906 columns (SNP loci), with genotypes coded as 0 (homozygous reference, aa), 1 (heterozygous, aA), 2 (homozygous alternate, AA) and NA (missing; about 13% of genotypes). Row names are sample IDs and column names are DArTseq locus IDs. All loci are polymorphic across the full dataset; monomorphic sites are not included.

example_meta: a data frame with 257 rows, in the same order as the rows of example_gt, and 3 columns:

sample

Sample ID, matching rownames(example_gt).

site

Collection site (55 sites).

population

Genetic group assignment (integer, 5 groups).

Source

Unpublished DArTseq data provided by the package author.

Examples

data(example_data)
dim(example_gt)
#> [1]  257 1906
example_gt[1:5, 1:5]
#>            X26095427.F.0.51.G.T.51.G.T X26097233.F.0.11.C.A.11.C.A
#> NSW1008199                           0                           2
#> NSW1008169                           0                           2
#> NSW1008189                           0                           2
#> NSW1008229                           0                           2
#> NSW1008224                           0                           2
#>            X26097154.F.0.27.G.C.27.G.C X26099383.F.0.35.A.G.35.A.G
#> NSW1008199                           0                           2
#> NSW1008169                           0                           2
#> NSW1008189                           0                           2
#> NSW1008229                           0                           2
#> NSW1008224                           0                           2
#>            X26101203.F.0.30.A.C.30.A.C
#> NSW1008199                           0
#> NSW1008169                           0
#> NSW1008189                           0
#> NSW1008229                           0
#> NSW1008224                           0
head(example_meta)
#>       sample         site population
#> 1 NSW1008199 Wambam_Creek          5
#> 2 NSW1008169 Wambam_Creek          5
#> 3 NSW1008189 Wambam_Creek          5
#> 4 NSW1008229 Wambam_Creek          5
#> 5 NSW1008224 Wambam_Creek          5
#> 6 NSW1009574 Wambam_Creek          5
table(example_meta$population)
#> 
#>   1   2   3   4   5 
#> 100  23  46  31  57
